Rohde & Schwarz 與 Qualcomm Technologies 使用 R&S CMX500 驗證 Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF 的 NG eCall functionality 符合 EN 17240:2024 [31]。
驗證流程使用 R&S CMX500 mobile radio tester 作為 NG eCall voice and data transmission 的 comprehensive testing solution [60]。
R&S CMX500 搭配 R&S CMX-KA098 software option 可在 realistic network conditions 下用於 NG eCall testing [60]。
eCall 自 2018 年起是歐盟新車 mandatory requirement，且來源稱 NG eCall 將自 2026-01-01 起 obligatory [33]。
R&S AREG800A 是 Rohde & Schwarz 的 Automotive Radar Echo Generator，用於 dynamic artificial object generation [4]。
AREG800A 的 echo generation concept 支援 hybrid 與 digital 兩種方式，最遠 generated distance 為 3000 m [8]。
AREG800A 每個 artificial object 支援 individual Doppler frequency shift，velocity setting range with R&S AREG8-B9 and R&S AREG8-B63 為 ±500 km/h [5]。
知識庫明示 AREG800A 用途為 automotive radar echo generation，不屬 RF signal generator 或 spectrum analyzer [9]。
5G NTN-NR gaining interest from chipset / device manufacturers、automotive、satellite / space industry [46]。
同一來源明示 R&S SMW200A 的 channel emulation capabilities 用於 NTN testing，包含 long path delays、enhanced Doppler capabilities 與 customized dynamic fading [46]。
NTN component testing 方案包含 DUT 搭配 R&S SMW200A 與 R&S FSW [51]。
在該方案中，R&S SMW200A frequency up to 67 GHz、RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz，with R&S SMW-K555 up to 4 GHz [51]。
在該方案中，R&S FSW frequency up to 85 GHz、overrange 90 GHz、analysis bandwidth up to 8 GHz [51]。

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S CMX500 | NG eCall voice and data transmission testing for automotive 4G/5G emergency-call implementations。[60] | R&S CMX-KA098 software option 可用於 NG eCall testing under realistic network conditions。[60] | 已被用於 Qualcomm Technologies 的 Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF NG eCall EN 17240:2024 verification。[31] | 測試模擬 PSAP，並驗證 implementation at both ends with EN 17240:2024。[60] | 來源未列 test case IDs、test conditions、network parameters、IMS setup、GNSS setup、software versions 或 pass/fail details。[35] |

| R&S SMW200A | NTN signal generator / channel emulation testing where automotive is listed as an interested market segment。[46] | R&S SMW200A frequency up to 67 GHz、overrange 72 GHz、RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz、with R&S SMW-K555 up to 4 GHz。[51] | 來源明示 SMW200A channel emulation capabilities 用於 NTN testing，包含 long path delays、enhanced Doppler capabilities 與 customized dynamic fading。[46] | NTN component testing 方案的 DUT 搭配 R&S SMW200A 與 R&S FSW。[51] | 來源只說 5G NTN-NR gaining interest from automotive，未證實具體 automotive customer fit 或 design win。[46] |

| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|

R&S AREG800A
[[R&S AREG800A]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Automotive Radar Echo Generator，用於 dynamic artificial object generation；本頁規格依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]]，文件版本 `Version 09.00`，文件日期 `September 2025（LA）`。

R&S AREG800A › Radial velocity 與 Doppler
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- 每個 artificial object 支援 individual Doppler frequency shift：`yes`。
- Velocity setting range with [[R&S AREG8-B9]] and [[R&S AREG8-B63]]：`±500 km/h`。
- Velocity step size：
  - [[R&S AREG8-B9]] and [[R&S AREG8-B63]]：`0.001 km/h`。
  - [[R&S AREG-DBP1]] / [[R&S AREG-DBP2]] / [[R&S AREG-DBP3]] with [[R&S AREG-MFP]] / [[R&S AREG-BFP]]：`0.05 km/h`。
- Doppler frequency offset accuracy：在 IF domain 以 spectrum analyzer 量測 base unit IF input 與 IF output signal 的 frequency offset，不含 frontend，`< 1 Hz`。
- Velocity accuracy：Doppler shift velocity error 由公式 `v_error = 3.6 × (f_error/f_center) × ½ × 299 700 000 m/s` 決定；`f_center` 為 `78 GHz` 或 `79 GHz`，適用於 [[R&S AREG8-81S]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WS]] 與 [[R&S AREG8-81D]] / [[R&S AREG8-81WD]]；velocity accuracy `< 0.05 km/h`。

R&S AREG800A › Level 與 IF transfer characteristics
| 項目 | 條件 | 規格 |
|---|---|---:|
| Spurious free dynamic range | RX IF input to TX IF output connector at AREG800A base unit, measured at –10 dBm signal level, [[R&S AREG8-B9]] | `> 35 dBc (typ.)` |
| Spurious free dynamic range | [[R&S AREG8-B9]] with [[R&S AREG8-K527]] | `> 35 dBc (typ.)` |
| Spurious free dynamic range | [[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option | `> 30 dBc (typ.)` |
| Suppression of ghost objects | measured from IF input to IF output connector at AREG800A base unit, [[R&S AREG8-B9]] | `> 40 dBc (meas.)` |
| Suppression of ghost objects | [[R&S AREG8-B9]] with 未完整標示 option | `> 40 dBc (meas.)` |

Suppression of ghost objects 量測條件：vector network analyzer in time domain；frequency step size `125 kHz`；measurement bandwidth `100 kHz`；source power `–10 dBm`；distance to wanted artificial object `2 m`；span 依 bandwidth 為 `1.1 GHz to 2.1 GHz`、`0.7 GHz to 2.7 GHz`、`0.7 GHz to 5.7 GHz`。

R&S AREG800A › Reference frequency input / output
Reference frequency input：REF IN on rear panel，BNC female；input frequency `10 MHz`；input level range `0 dBm to +13 dBm`；input impedance `50 Ω (nom.)`，AC coupled。

Reference frequency output：REF OUT on rear panel，BNC female；output frequency square wave；source mode internal 為 `10 MHz ± 5 ppm (nom.)`，derived from internal oscillator；source mode external 為 amplified input signal from REF IN routed to REF OUT；output level `+10 dBm (meas.)`；source impedance `50 Ω (nom.)`，AC coupled。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

本來源已對應既有來源頁 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] 與實體頁 [[R&S AREG800A]]。本次 ingest 依同一 raw source 重新校對既有頁面，補入或修正：
